templates.name: Edge-Radar: Morning Scan (preview)
templates.description: Scans today's Kalshi sports markets against 12 sportsbooks and saves a ranked report of edges. Preview only: never places an order. Default 12:00 UTC (8 AM US Eastern in summer). Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

templates.name: Edge-Radar: Morning Scan + Execute
templates.description: Scans today's games and sizes up to 5 bets with Kelly, skipping markets you already hold. Starts in preview: no orders until you set Mode to execute, and even then only when DRY_RUN=false in your .env. In execute mode it places REAL Kalshi orders, Kelly-sized, through every risk gate (daily loss limit, exposure caps, per-event limits). Read docs/setup/AUTOMATION_GUIDE.md first. Default 12:00 UTC (8 AM US Eastern in summer). Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

templates.name: Edge-Radar: Next-Day Scan + Execute
templates.description: Scans tomorrow's games the night before, to catch early lines; not every market is posted yet. Starts in preview: no orders until you set Mode to execute, and even then only when DRY_RUN=false in your .env. In execute mode it places REAL Kalshi orders, Kelly-sized, through every risk gate (daily loss limit, exposure caps, per-event limits). Read docs/setup/AUTOMATION_GUIDE.md first. Default 01:00 UTC (9 PM US Eastern in summer). Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

templates.name: Edge-Radar: Hourly Settlement
templates.description: Settles finished trades against Kalshi, records realized P&L and closing-line value, and keeps the daily-loss gate's view current. Idempotent, places no orders. Hourly at :35. Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

templates.name: Edge-Radar: Weekly Calibration
templates.description: 30-day calibration report (Brier score, calibration curve, recommendations) saved to reports/Calibration/. Places no orders. Default Sunday 23:00 UTC (7 PM US Eastern in summer). Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

templates.name: Edge-Radar: Weekly Odds API Key Probe
templates.description: Probes each Odds API key's remaining quota, so a drained or dead key shows up before a scan needs it. One request per key. Default Sunday 22:00 UTC (6 PM US Eastern in summer). Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

packs.name: Edge-Radar
packs.description: Scheduled scans, settlement and upkeep for Edge-Radar's Kalshi edge-detection system. The two that can place orders start in preview.
